title: DF-001 — P1 Daemon control channel broken: `openapi-daemon start/status/stop` lie. Dogfood 2026-08-07: `start --backend-url http://localhost:9801 --socket-path /tmp/m3.sock` prints 'Daemon started successfully' + 'PID file: /tmp/m3.sock.pid' but NO pid/token file exists (ls shows only the socket); `status` reports 'Running: false' + zero start time WHILE the proxy actively serves curl through the socket; `stop` prints 'Daemon is not running' and the daemon KEEPS serving (verified via curl after stop). Only foreground `proxy` mode works, and it cannot be stopped by any documented command (must kill -9). Root cause: pkg/daemon Controller tracks running/startTime as in-process state only (proxy.go:76-118); status/stop run in a separate process and always see running=false; cmd/daemon start prints the PID path but the file is never written. Integration guide §3 'verified' start→run→stop sequence FAILS at stop. Fix: persist PID (and token) files on start, make Status()/Stop() read the PID file + signal the live process (internal/builtin/daemon.go:211-250 already does this correctly — reuse that logic). PASS: `start` then `status` shows Running: true; `stop` terminates the proxy and removes the socket.
